title: policy.json: project
description: Who the project is. Has no defaults: every project sets its own ID and key.

id.description: The project ID. Names the private store directory (design part 3.3), so it is a single safe path segment.

key.description: The tracker ID key: items are <key>-<n> (design part 3.1). SIG, P, C and D are reserved for signals, precedents, contributors and dispatches.

classification_ceiling.description: The highest classification allowed in the repository. public for a public repository; the check refuses anything above it (design part 10.3).

private_paths.description: Path globs, relative to the repository root, whose files are never public, whatever their front matter says. The commit guard, the merge and hitld work check refuse them when the ceiling is public (design part 10.3, rule 3). * matches within a path segment, ** across segments.
